Study all AVAILABLE THX, CCZ, QJZ and DYC specimens, preserve all defining stroke branches, open gaps, closed counters, detachments and bar-length relationships. Choose one coherent attested whole construction; never blend incompatible variants and never substitute a modern Chinese character. Choose THX construction when corroborated, considering every source. Redraw as harmonious Gothic sans-serif monoline font centerline trajectories with absolutely CONSTANT stroke width, smooth rounded Bézier-like curves, precise straight bars, round caps and round joins. No taper, pressure, brush perimeter, texture, serif or blobs. Every stroke identical width approximately3% of square canvas; keep dense counters and gaps open. Exactly one complete glyph centered in central70%, generous empty margins. Pure BLACK strokes fully TRANSPARENT background. No text,labels,codepoint,frame,chart,grid,watermark,color,shadows or other specimens. Structural reading aid: THX central one figure: upper shallow chevron roof with short upward central stub and descending central staff attached top of small closed oval. Staff exits oval bottom and meets lower outer inverted-U roof with long two free legs. Central staff continues INSIDE lower roof through second small closed oval, then through three-pronged fork cup and one horizontal crossbar below cup, ending long free bottom. Keep cup side tips and internal oval detached from outer arch, but central staff joins outer roof midpoint.
